hskInfoModal.title: How HSK level is estimated
hskInfoModal.text: This HSK level is an estimate based on the characters you know. A level counts as reached when you know at least {{percent}}% of all characters expected up to that level — for example, HSK 3 needs {{percent}}% of HSK 1, 2, and 3 combined. The missing-characters list includes gaps from earlier levels too, so you can fill those first. Less useful characters can wait while you learn more frequent ones.
